操作員角色允許的代理程式

text: Always may require System Settings to approve background location.
translated: 選擇「永遠」可能需要在「系統設定」中核准背景位置存取權限。

text: Embedding model override used by the selected memory provider when a non-default model is required. Set this only when you need explicit recall quality/cost tuning beyond provider defaults.
translated: 需要非預設模型時，用來覆寫所選記憶供應商使用的嵌入模型。只有在需要超出供應商預設設定，明確調整檢索品質或成本時，才設定此項目。

text: Explicit key/value environment variable overrides merged into runtime process environment for OpenClaw. Use this for deterministic env configuration instead of relying only on shell profile side effects.
translated: 明確指定的索引鍵／值環境變數覆寫，會合併至 OpenClaw 執行階段的程序環境。使用此設定可確保環境設定明確可控，而非僅依賴 Shell 設定檔的間接影響。

text: No skills in this library. Create one or import a bundle.
translated: 此技能庫中沒有技能。請建立技能或匯入套件。

text: A source opts in to capture when applied by the Gateway. Removing an entry stops its configured auto-start capture after the change takes effect; saved notes remain.
translated: Gateway 套用設定後，來源便會啟用記錄。移除項目後，該來源設定的自動啟動記錄會在變更生效後停止；已儲存的筆記會保留。
允許掛鉤請求提供工作階段金鑰

text: Three links worth your coffee, with hot takes.
translated: 三個值得配咖啡閱讀的連結，附上犀利短評。

text: Could not start learning. Check your sessions before trying again.
translated: 無法開始學習。請先檢查您的工作階段，再重試。

text: The secret was not deleted. Reload the list and try again.
translated: 未刪除機密。 請重新載入清單並再試一次。
啟用記憶搜尋多模態功能
配對 QR 碼已過期

text: Default pair loop protection settings for channel providers that support bot-to-bot loop guards. Use provider-specific overrides only when one channel needs a different budget.
translated: 適用於支援機器人間迴圈防護的頻道供應商之預設配對迴圈防護設定。僅在個別頻道需要不同額度時，才使用供應商專屬覆寫設定。

text: Explicitly restrict optional tools such as browser, automations, and message. Off by default; supported local runtimes use automatic Tool Search without this restriction. Explicit tool allows and required delivery tools are preserved.
translated: 明確限制 browser、automations 和 message 等選用工具。預設為關閉；支援的本機執行環境會使用自動工具搜尋，不受此限制。明確允許的工具與必要的傳送工具會予以保留。

text: Client TLS certificate presented to the upstream endpoint when mutual TLS is required.
translated: 需要雙向 TLS 時，向上游端點提供的用戶端 TLS 憑證。
自訂外掛程式使用者介面

text: Optional group/channel session scope override for this route binding. "per-group" keeps matched rooms separate and ambiently watched by the agent main session regardless of dmScope; "main" merges their context into main and needs no watch.
translated: 此路由綁定的選用群組／頻道工作階段範圍覆寫設定。"per-group" 會將匹配的聊天室分開，並由代理程式的主要工作階段在背景持續監看，不受 dmScope 影響；"main" 則會將其上下文合併至主要工作階段，無須監看。

text: This automation has an invalid schedule or payload.
translated: 此自動化作業的排程或酬載無效。
正在檢查您的模型設定…

text: Controls whether this plugin may mutate prompts through typed hooks. Set false to block `before_prompt_build`.
translated: 控制此外掛程式是否可透過具型別掛鉤修改提示。設為 false 可封鎖 `before_prompt_build`。

text: Agent that owns ambient heartbeat runs when no per-agent heartbeat configuration exists. Leave unset to preserve configured-default routing.
translated: 未設定個別代理程式心跳時，負責執行背景心跳的代理程式。保持未設定即可保留已設定的預設路由。

text: OpenClaw cannot confirm or record a decision while disconnected. Reconnect to check the current status.
translated: OpenClaw 無法在連線中斷時確認或記錄決定。請重新連線以查看目前狀態。
依序使用的備援影片生成模型（provider/model）。

text: Maximum number of hidden catalog search results a code-mode program can request.
translated: 程式碼模式程式可請求的隱藏目錄搜尋結果數量上限。

text: Adds this account's public GitHub noreply address to commits created from shared sessions. Turning it off affects future commits only.
translated: 將此帳號的公開 GitHub noreply 電子郵件地址加入從共用工作階段建立的提交中。 關閉此功能只會影響之後的提交。

text: Per-provider tool allow/deny overrides keyed by channel/provider ID to tailor capabilities by surface. Use this when one provider needs stricter controls than global tool policy.
translated: 以通道／提供者 ID 為索引鍵，為各提供者覆寫工具允許／拒絕設定，以針對不同使用介面調整功能。當某個提供者需要比全域工具政策更嚴格的控管時，請使用此設定。

text: Pick an agent to inspect its workspace and tools.
translated: 選擇代理以檢視其工作區與工具。

text: Sets inactivity window before reset for idle mode and can also act as secondary guard with daily mode. Use larger values to preserve continuity or smaller values for fresher short-lived threads.
translated: 設定閒置模式下觸發重設前的無活動時長，也可在每日模式中作為額外的防護條件。使用較大的值可維持連續性，較小的值則適合更常更新的短期對話串。

text: Per-agent message action allowlist for the message tool. Set to a minimal list such as ["send"] for public sandbox agents so read, edit, delete, reaction, and other provider-specific message actions stay hidden and blocked.
translated: message 工具中各代理程式的訊息動作允許清單。針對公開沙箱代理程式，請設為最精簡的清單，例如 ["send"]，以便隱藏並封鎖讀取、編輯、刪除、表情回應及其他供應商專屬的訊息動作。
完整存取需要 operator.admin 權限。

text: Optional bootstrap files that should not be created in agent workspaces. Valid values: SOUL.md, USER.md, IDENTITY.md (HEARTBEAT.md is accepted but a no-op).
translated: 不應在代理程式工作區中建立的選用初始化檔案。有效值：SOUL.md、USER.md、IDENTITY.md（接受 HEARTBEAT.md，但不會產生任何作用）。

text: Overnight issues, PRs, and CI failures, ranked by urgency.
translated: 依緊急程度排序的隔夜議題、提取要求及 CI 失敗。

text: Defines reset policy for group chat sessions where continuity and noise patterns differ from DMs. Use shorter idle windows for busy groups if context drift becomes a problem.
translated: 定義群組聊天工作階段的重設原則，其對話連貫性與雜訊模式和直接訊息不同。若上下文偏移成為問題，可為訊息頻繁的群組設定較短的閒置時限。

text: Allows trusted Tailscale identity paths to satisfy gateway auth checks when configured. Use this only when your tailnet identity posture is strong and operator workflows depend on it.
translated: 設定後，允許透過受信任的 Tailscale 身分途徑通過 Gateway 驗證檢查。僅在 tailnet 身分安全機制完善，且操作人員工作流程依賴此功能時使用。

text: Accept agent-visible plugin tool descriptors published by paired nodes (default: true). Set false to ignore and remove all node-published plugin tools.
translated: 接受由已配對節點發佈、對代理程式可見的外掛工具描述資訊（預設值：true）。設為 false 可忽略並移除所有由節點發佈的外掛工具。

text: Example: Make this use Gmail labels instead of unread search, and add a safer dry-run step.
translated: 範例: 改用 Gmail 標籤而非搜尋未讀郵件，並新增更安全的模擬執行步驟。
請修正 {count} 個欄位以繼續。
啟用節點工作程序執行

text: If using pnpm ui:dev, rebuild or restart the dev UI against the current checkout.
translated: 若使用 pnpm ui:dev，請根據目前簽出的程式碼重新建置或重新啟動開發版 UI。

text: Some models could not be refreshed. Open Models to try again.
translated: 部分模型無法重新整理。請開啟「模型」再試一次。

text: Enables serving the gateway Control UI from the gateway HTTP process when true. Keep enabled for local administration, and disable when an external control surface replaces it.
translated: 設為 true 時，會透過 Gateway HTTP 程序提供 Gateway Control UI。若要進行本機管理，請保持啟用；若已由外部控制介面取代，則可停用。

text: Companion apps for your phone, watch, desktop, and browser — plus plugins to extend what your agent can do.
translated: 適用於手機、手錶、桌面和瀏覽器的配套應用程式 — 還有外掛程式可擴充代理程式的功能。

text: If this is a shared host, check other clients for repeated bad retries.
translated: 如果這是共用主機，請檢查其他用戶端是否持續以錯誤的驗證資訊重試。

text: Optional account selector for multi-account channel setups when plugin approvals must route through a specific account context.
translated: 多帳號頻道設定中的選用帳號選擇器，適用於必須透過特定帳號情境路由外掛程式核准的情況。

text: Live config-reload policy for how edits are applied and when full restarts are triggered. Keep hybrid behavior for safest operational updates unless debugging reload internals.
translated: 即時重新載入設定的策略，決定如何套用編輯內容，以及何時觸發完整重新啟動。除非正在對重新載入的內部機制進行偵錯，否則請保留混合模式，以最安全的方式更新運作中的設定。

text: Configuration is unavailable. Refresh and try again.
translated: 無法取得設定。請重新整理後再試。

text: This session has no dashboard widgets yet.
translated: 此工作階段尚無儀表板小工具。

text: Controls citation visibility in replies: "auto" shows citations when useful, "on" always shows them, and "off" hides them. Keep "auto" for a balanced signal-to-noise default.
translated: 控制回覆中的引用顯示方式："auto" 在有幫助時顯示引用，"on" 一律顯示，"off" 則隱藏。保留 "auto" 可在資訊量與干擾之間取得平衡，作為預設設定。
代理程式的 ACP 執行框架代理程式

text: Enable desktop.host.enabled: true in the node config and add desktop.stream to gateway.nodes.commands.allow, then restart both. The node reconnects with a pending reapproval for desktop.stream; approve it here or with openclaw nodes approve.
translated: 在節點設定中啟用 desktop.host.enabled: true，並將 desktop.stream 加入 gateway.nodes.commands.allow，然後重新啟動節點和 Gateway。節點重新連線後，desktop.stream 將等待重新核准；請在此處或使用 openclaw nodes approve 核准。

text: Pick a folder before starting in a terminal.
translated: 請先選擇資料夾，再於終端機中啟動。
設定已在其他地方變更
無法載入已安裝的技能
顯示前 {count} 行未修改的內容

text: Search projects or paste a Git URL
translated: 搜尋專案或貼上 Git URL

text: Original uses your Mac’s icon style. Other designs follow light/dark mode while OpenClaw runs.
translated: 原始設計會使用 Mac 的圖像樣式。其他設計會在 OpenClaw 執行時配合淺色／深色模式。

text: Connect to an available remote desktop.
translated: 連線至可用的遠端桌面。

text: Ask the agent to start a portal:

translated: 功能統計同意時間戳記

text: Delete {count} archived sessions and their transcripts? Any attached workers will be stopped safely first.
translated: 要刪除 {count} 個已封存的工作階段及其對話記錄嗎？ 所有附加的工作程序都會先安全停止。

text: Use tools provided by MCP servers on this device.
translated: 使用此裝置上的 MCP 伺服器所提供的工具。

text: ACP runtime controls for enabling dispatch, selecting backends, constraining allowed agent targets, and selecting streamed turn projection behavior.
translated: ACP 執行環境控制項，可用於啟用分派、選擇後端、限制允許的目標代理程式，以及選擇串流回合的投射行為。
MCP App 沙箱無法使用

text: Total message and tool errors in range.
translated: 範圍內的訊息與工具錯誤總數。

text: Per-agent maximum time in seconds allowed for a heartbeat agent turn before it is aborted. Leave unset to inherit the merged heartbeat timeout, then agents.defaults.timeoutSeconds when set, otherwise the heartbeat cadence capped at 600 seconds.
translated: 個別代理程式執行心跳回合所允許的最長時間（秒），超過後即中止。留空時會繼承合併後的心跳逾時值，其次採用已設定的 agents.defaults.timeoutSeconds；若皆未設定，則採用心跳間隔，上限為 600 秒。

text: Per-agent override for lean local-model mode. Enable it for one smaller local-model agent without trimming tools from every agent.
translated: 針對個別代理覆寫精簡本機模型模式。可為使用較小本機模型的單一代理啟用此模式，而無須刪減所有代理的工具。

text: Optional stable identifier for a hook mapping entry used for auditing, troubleshooting, and targeted updates. Use unique IDs so logs and config diffs can reference mappings unambiguously.
translated: 掛鉤對應項目的選用固定識別碼，用於稽核、疑難排解及針對性更新。請使用唯一 ID，讓日誌與設定差異能明確參照對應項目。

text: Stop retrying from this tab for a moment.
translated: 請暫時停止從此分頁重試。

text: Quality-audit retry settings for safeguard compaction summaries. Safeguard mode enables this by default; set enabled: false to skip summary audits and regeneration.
translated: 防護式壓縮摘要的品質稽核重試設定。防護模式預設啟用此功能；設定 enabled: false 可略過摘要稽核與重新產生。
Control UI 建置詳細資訊

text: Optional per-agent overrides for the focused context budget knobs. Omitted fields inherit agents.defaults.contextLimits.
translated: 可選的個別代理覆寫設定，用於調整特定上下文容量限制。省略的欄位會繼承 agents.defaults.contextLimits。
無輸出 — 工具執行失敗。
來自環境變數的 API 金鑰

text: Condition triggers are disabled. Existing configuration is preserved until you clear it.
translated: 條件觸發器已停用。現有設定會保留，直到您將其清除。

text: No decision receipts were returned for this bounded page.
translated: 此限定範圍的頁面未傳回任何決策回執。

text: Explicitly allows this plugin to request model overrides in api.runtime.llm.complete. Keep false unless the plugin is trusted to steer model selection.
translated: 明確允許此外掛程式在 api.runtime.llm.complete 中要求覆寫模型。除非信任此外掛程式可決定模型選擇，否則請維持 false。

text: Use this to set true or false fast mode for the regular agent run behind Talk realtime consults.
translated: 使用此設定，將對話即時諮詢背後的一般代理程式執行作業的快速模式設為 true 或 false。

text: Ordered fallback models (provider/model). Used when the primary model fails.
translated: 依序使用的備援模型（provider/model）。主要模型失敗時使用。
代理程式 GitHub CLI 身分覆寫

text: The camera is busy or unavailable to the browser.
translated: 相機忙碌中或瀏覽器無法使用相機。

text: Additional HTTP request headers sent with OpenTelemetry export requests, often used for tenant auth or routing. Keep secrets in env-backed values and avoid unnecessary header sprawl.
translated: 隨 OpenTelemetry 匯出請求傳送的額外 HTTP 請求標頭，通常用於租戶驗證或路由。請將機密資訊存放在由環境變數提供的值中，並避免加入不必要的標頭。

text: Testing — asking the selected model for a quick reply…
translated: 正在測試 — 要求所選模型提供簡短回覆…

text: Adds custom HTTP headers to remote embedding requests, merged with provider defaults. Use this for proxy auth and tenant routing headers, and keep values minimal to avoid leaking sensitive metadata.
translated: 在遠端嵌入向量請求中加入自訂 HTTP 標頭，並與供應商預設值合併。可用於代理驗證及租戶路由標頭，並請將標頭值限制在必要的最少範圍，以免洩漏敏感中繼資料。

text: Named browser profile connection map used for explicit routing to CDP ports or URLs with optional metadata. Keep profile names consistent and avoid overlapping endpoint definitions.
translated: 具名瀏覽器設定檔的連線對應表，用於明確路由至 CDP 連接埠或 URL，並可選擇附加中繼資料。請保持設定檔名稱一致，並避免端點定義重疊。

text: Agent whose model and credentials own ambient system-agent and Custodian consults. Also used when models.list, models.authStatus, skills.status, doctor.memory.status, or an infer CLI command that resolves agent-owned model or auth state omits agentId or --agent; explicit request agentId always wins.
translated: 提供模型與憑證，供背景系統代理與 Custodian 諮詢使用的代理。當 models.list、models.authStatus、skills.status、doctor.memory.status，或用於解析代理所屬模型或驗證狀態的 infer CLI 命令未指定 agentId 或 --agent 時，也會使用此代理；請求中明確指定的 agentId 一律優先。

text: Cannot safely insert an uploaded path into unsupported shell: {shell}
translated: 無法將已上傳檔案路徑安全地插入不支援的 shell: {shell}
工作階段每日重設時刻

text: Removed {removed} duplicate dream entry and kept {kept}.
translated: 已移除 {removed} 筆重複的夢境記錄並保留 {kept} 筆。

text: Weekly reviews paused. Enable cron in Automation settings.
translated: 每週審查已暫停。請在自動化設定中啟用 cron。

text: Pin agents to a specific node when using exec host=node.
translated: 使用 exec host=node 時，將代理固定至特定節點。

text: Enable lifecycle status reactions on supported channels. Discord treats unset as enabled when ack reactions are active; Slack, Signal, Telegram, and WhatsApp require this to be true before lifecycle reactions are used. Slack uses native assistant thread status for progress by default.
translated: 在支援的頻道上啟用生命週期狀態表情回應。當確認表情回應啟用時，Discord 會將未設定視為啟用；Slack、Signal、Telegram 和 WhatsApp 則要求此設定為 true，才會使用生命週期表情回應。Slack 預設使用原生助理討論串狀態來顯示進度。
實驗性 Control UI 功能

text: The Gateway is reachable, but it rejected the proxy identity or forwarding information.
translated: 可以連線至 Gateway，但它拒絕了 Proxy 身分或轉送資訊。

text: Enable image understanding so attached or referenced images can be interpreted into textual context. Disable if you need text-only operation or want to avoid image-processing cost.
translated: 啟用影像理解，將附加或引用的影像解讀為文字脈絡。若需要僅處理文字，或想避免影像處理費用，請停用此功能。

text: Connect to the gateway to import memory.
translated: 請連線至 Gateway 以匯入記憶。

text: Configuration file opened on Gateway host.
translated: 已在 Gateway 主機上開啟設定檔。

text: From the plugin manifest. OpenClaw validates the plugin against these declarations when it loads.
translated: 來自外掛程式資訊清單。 OpenClaw 會在載入外掛程式時依據這些宣告進行驗證。

text: Explicit browser executable path when auto-discovery is insufficient for your host environment. Use an absolute stable path, or a path starting with ~ for your OS home directory, so launch behavior stays deterministic across restarts.
translated: 當自動探索不足以滿足主機環境需求時，明確指定瀏覽器執行檔路徑。請使用固定的絕對路徑，或以 ~ 開頭、指向作業系統家目錄的路徑，確保重新啟動後的啟動行為保持一致。

text: Remote Gateway WebSocket URL (ws:// or wss://).
translated: 遠端 Gateway WebSocket URL（ws:// 或 wss://）。

text: Add a visible origin marker when sending cross-context (default: true).
translated: 跨情境傳送時加入可見的來源標記（預設值：true）。

text: Wait for the auth limiter to cool down, then reconnect with the corrected credential.
translated: 請等待驗證限制解除，再使用更正後的憑證重新連線。

text: Channel/provider ID used for forwarded plugin approval delivery, such as discord, slack, or a plugin channel id.
translated: 用於傳送轉送之外掛程式核准的頻道／提供者 ID，例如 discord、slack 或外掛程式頻道 ID。

text: Approval history is a rolling 30-day window.
translated: 核准歷史紀錄僅保留最近 30 天的資料。

text: Mentions could not be updated. Refresh or try dismissing again.
translated: 無法更新提及。請重新整理或再次嘗試關閉。

text: Binding kind. Use "route" (or omit for legacy route entries) for normal routing, and "acp" for persistent ACP conversation bindings.
translated: 綁定的種類。一般路由使用 "route"（舊版路由項目可省略），持續性的 ACP 對話綁定則使用 "acp"。

text: Sync cookies to the remote computer
translated: 將 Cookie 同步至遠端電腦
正在載入已安裝的技能…

text: mDNS broadcast mode ("minimal" default, "full" includes cliPath/sshPort, "off" disables mDNS).
translated: mDNS 廣播模式（預設為 "minimal"，"full" 包含 cliPath/sshPort，"off" 停用 mDNS）。

text: Install the available update and restart the Gateway.
translated: 安裝可用的更新並重新啟動 Gateway.
在 {group} 中新增工作階段

text: Expose the local browser control server through node proxy routing so remote clients can use this host's browser capabilities. Keep disabled unless remote automation explicitly depends on it.
translated: 透過節點代理路由提供本機瀏覽器控制伺服器，讓遠端用戶端能使用此主機的瀏覽器功能。除非遠端自動化明確依賴此功能，否則請保持停用。

text: DM access approved, but requester notification and command-owner setup both failed.
translated: 已核准私訊存取權限，但傳送申請者通知和設定指令擁有者皆失敗。

text: Pairing delivery could not be confirmed

translated: 透過 Gateway 權杖或通道連線，而非使用個人帳號登入。

translated: 選擇要在壓縮後重新注入的 AGENTS.md H2/H3 區段名稱。保持未設定或設為 [] 可停用重新注入。明確設為 ["Session Startup", "Red Lines"] 可啟用舊版預設的兩個區段。

text: Maximum runtime allowed for mapping action execution before timeout handling applies. Use tighter limits for high-volume webhook sources to prevent queue pileups.
translated: 映射動作在觸發逾時處理前允許執行的最長時間。對於高流量的 webhook 來源，請設定較嚴格的時間限制，以避免佇列堆積。

text: Optional repository root shown in the system prompt runtime line (overrides auto-detect).
translated: 顯示於系統提示詞執行階段資訊列的選用儲存庫根目錄（覆寫自動偵測結果）。

text: Default target agent for swarm spawns that omit agentId. The subagent allowlist still applies.
translated: 群集衍生時未指定 agentId 所使用的預設目標代理程式。子代理程式允許清單仍然適用。

text: Optional SNI/server-name override used when establishing TLS to the proxy.
translated: 與代理伺服器建立 TLS 連線時使用的選用 SNI／伺服器名稱覆寫值。

text: Per-agent override for max characters of each workspace bootstrap file injected into this agent's system prompt. Omit to inherit agents.defaults.bootstrapMaxChars.
translated: 為個別代理覆寫注入其系統提示的每個工作區啟動初始化檔案的字元數上限。省略則繼承 agents.defaults.bootstrapMaxChars。

text: Default audio input size limit for configured and auto-detected models. Set this to the largest recording your providers and network should accept.
translated: 已設定及自動偵測模型的預設音訊輸入大小上限。請將此值設為供應商與網路可接受的最大錄音大小。

text: Voice used for spoken replies. GPT-Live locks the voice once a call starts.
translated: 用於語音回覆的音色。GPT-Live 會在通話開始後鎖定音色。

text: Side chat reached its question limit. Try again shortly.
translated: 側邊聊天已達提問上限。請稍後再試。

text: Approximate city sent to native Codex web search.
translated: 傳送至原生 Codex 網頁搜尋的大致所在城市。
未變更: {target} 程式庫中的 {slug} (擁有者: {owner})。

text: Provider-specific Talk settings keyed by provider id. During migration, prefer this over legacy talk.* keys.
translated: 以供應商 ID 為索引鍵的供應商專屬對話設定。遷移期間，請優先使用此設定，而非舊版 talk.* 設定鍵。

text: Checking the current approval state with the Gateway.
translated: 正在向 Gateway 查詢目前的核准狀態。
影片生成逾時時間（毫秒）

text: SSH-verified auto-approval for first-time node-role device pairing (default: enabled). The gateway SSHes back to the pairing host (BatchMode, strict host keys) and approves only when the remote `openclaw node identity` output matches the pending device key. Set false to disable SSH verification (independent of autoApproveCidrs, which stays active); for manual-only pairing also unset autoApproveCidrs. Pass an object to override user/identity/timeoutMs/cidrs.
translated: 對節點角色裝置的首次配對進行 SSH 驗證後自動核准（預設：啟用）。Gateway 會透過 SSH 反向連線至配對主機（BatchMode、嚴格主機金鑰檢查），且僅在遠端 `openclaw node identity` 的輸出與待核准的裝置金鑰相符時核准。設為 false 可停用 SSH 驗證（與 autoApproveCidrs 無關，後者仍保持作用）；若要僅允許手動配對，還需取消設定 autoApproveCidrs。傳入物件可覆寫 user/identity/timeoutMs/cidrs。
尚未設定 AI 供應商

text: Added {name}. Authenticate with “{command}”, then restart the gateway.
translated: 已新增 {name}. 請使用 “{command}” 進行驗證，然後重新啟動 Gateway.

text: IANA timezone used to interpret the cron cadence.
translated: 用於解讀 cron 排程頻率的 IANA 時區。
瀏覽器設定檔執行檔路徑

text: This session's runner failed and cannot accept messages.
translated: 此工作階段的執行器已失敗，無法接收訊息。

text: Delay in milliseconds before showing an in-progress notice after an exec approval is granted. Increase to reduce flicker for fast commands, or lower for quicker operator feedback.
translated: 執行獲准後，顯示進行中通知前的延遲時間（毫秒）。增加此值可減少快速完成的命令造成的閃爍，降低此值則可更快向操作人員提供回饋。
範圍內不重複的工作階段。

translated: 未清除任何已儲存的 WhatsApp 工作階段。 工作階段可能已不存在, 或其驗證目錄可能需要手動清理。

text: Control UI hosting settings including enablement, pathing, and browser-origin/auth hardening behavior. Keep UI exposure minimal and pair with strong auth controls before internet-facing deployments.
translated: Control UI 託管設定，包括啟用狀態、路徑設定，以及瀏覽器來源與驗證的安全強化行為。請盡量縮小 UI 的對外暴露範圍，並在部署至網際網路前搭配強式驗證控制措施。

text: Image-tool media compression preference: "auto" adapts to provider/model limits and image count, "efficient" saves tokens and bytes, "balanced" keeps the current middle ground, and "high" preserves more detail for screenshots and document images.
translated: 影像工具的媒體壓縮偏好設定："auto" 會依供應商／模型的限制及影像數量自動調整，"efficient" 可節省 token 和位元組，"balanced" 維持目前的折衷設定，而 "high" 則為螢幕截圖和文件影像保留更多細節。
已暫存 {count} 項; 將透過做夢機制轉為正式記憶

text: Connect to the gateway to change MCP servers.
translated: 請連線至 Gateway 以變更 MCP 伺服器。

text: Could not update connected accounts. Try again.
translated: 無法更新已連結的帳號。 請再試一次。
不支援的類型: {type}. 請使用原始模式。
篩選已安裝的外掛程式

text: Optional Node 24.16+ or 26.1+ image for container-isolated workers (default: "node:24.19.0-slim"). Use a digest-pinned, private-registry, or preloaded image when needed; missing images are pulled on first use.
translated: 用於容器隔離工作程序的選用 Node 24.16+ 或 26.1+ 映像（預設值："node:24.19.0-slim"）。可視需要使用以摘要鎖定版本、來自私有映像登錄庫或預先載入的映像；缺少的映像會在首次使用時拉取。

text: Use the native GitHub identity for new runs?
translated: 新執行作業要使用原生 GitHub 身分嗎？

text: Removed {removed} duplicate dream entries and kept {kept}.
translated: 已移除 {removed} 筆重複的夢境記錄並保留 {kept} 筆。

text: When true (default), suppress repeated ACP status/tool projection lines in a turn while keeping raw ACP events unchanged.
translated: 設為 true（預設值）時，抑制同一回合中重複的 ACP 狀態／工具投影行，同時保持原始 ACP 事件不變。

text: Controls chat command surfaces, owner gating, and elevated command access behavior across providers. Keep defaults unless you need stricter operator controls or broader command availability.
translated: 控制各供應商的聊天指令介面、擁有者存取限制，以及指令的提權存取行為。除非需要更嚴格的操作人員管控或更廣泛的指令可用範圍，否則請保留預設值。

text: Default cloud worker profile names keyed by normalized lowercase repository identity (host/owner/repo). Explicit dispatch profile ids take precedence.
translated: 以正規化為小寫的儲存庫識別資訊 (host/owner/repo) 為索引鍵的預設雲端工作節點設定檔名稱。明確指定的派送設定檔 ID 優先。

text: Reported by the active Gateway connection; separate from this Control UI build.
translated: 由目前的 Gateway 連線回報; 與此 Control UI 建置版本不同。
沒有可使用 system.run 的節點。
要登出 WhatsApp 帳號 {accountId} 嗎？

text: Sends your text to the gateway main timeline (good for reminders).
translated: 將您的文字傳送至 Gateway 主時間軸 (適合用於提醒)。

translated: 無需審查; 檔案存取與命令執行皆不受限制。

translated: 請嘗試搜尋其他檔案名稱或內容。

text: When true, mapping content may include less-sanitized external payload data in generated messages. Keep false by default and enable only for trusted sources with reviewed transform logic.
translated: 設為 true 時，對應內容可在產生的訊息中包含未經充分淨化的外部酬載資料。預設應保持 false，僅針對可信任且轉換邏輯經過審查的來源啟用。

text: Current short-term candidates waiting to graduate into real memory.
translated: 目前等待晉升為正式記憶的短期候選項目。

text: No applicable grants were recorded for this run.
translated: 此次執行未記錄任何適用的授權。

text: Queued attachments are missing or unreadable. This may be a stale copy from another tab. Check the conversation, then discard this row and attach the files again if needed. No new message was sent.
translated: 佇列中的附件遺失或無法讀取。這可能是來自另一個分頁的過期副本。請檢查對話，然後捨棄此列，並視需要重新附加檔案。未傳送任何新訊息。

text: The gateway returned an invalid task list.
translated: Gateway 傳回了無效的任務清單。

text: Download failed. No partial file was downloaded. Try again, or use the Transcripts CLI for exports over the browser limit.
translated: 下載失敗，未下載任何不完整的檔案。請重試；若匯出內容超過瀏覽器限制，請使用 Transcripts CLI。
沒有使用中的工作階段。

text: Voice Wake is unavailable on this Mac. It requires macOS 26 or newer and on-device recognition for the selected language.
translated: 這部 Mac 無法使用語音喚醒。此功能需要 macOS 26 或更新版本，且所選語言須支援裝置端辨識。

text: Released browser/Gateway-owned WebRTC tries OAuth first and falls back to a Platform API key. Direct backend sockets and unlisted or private routes require Platform API-key access. Delegated work can be steered while running and requires exact spoken confirmation for high-impact actions.
translated: 已發布且由瀏覽器／Gateway 管理的 WebRTC 會先嘗試 OAuth，若失敗則改用 Platform API 金鑰。直接後端通訊端及未列出或私人路由需要 Platform API 金鑰存取權。委派的工作可在執行期間調整方向，而高影響操作則需要精確的口頭確認。

text: Vector search over MEMORY.md and memory/*.md (per-agent overrides supported).
translated: 對 MEMORY.md 和 memory/*.md 進行向量搜尋（支援個別代理覆寫設定）。

text: Keep the screen awake while OpenClaw is active.
translated: 在 OpenClaw 運作時保持螢幕喚醒。

text: Per-sessionUpdate visibility overrides for ACP projection (for example usage_update, available_commands_update).
translated: 依各個 sessionUpdate 設定 ACP 投影的可見性覆寫值（例如 usage_update、available_commands_update）。

text: Restrict apply_patch paths to the workspace directory (default: true). Set false to allow writing outside the workspace (dangerous).
translated: 將 apply_patch 路徑限制於工作區目錄內（預設：true）。設為 false 可允許寫入工作區以外的位置（危險）。

text: Default maximum output token budget applied to models under this provider when a model entry does not set maxTokens.
translated: 當模型項目未設定 maxTokens 時，套用至此供應商旗下模型的預設最大輸出詞元額度。

text: Master toggle for diagnostics instrumentation output in logs and telemetry wiring paths. Defaults to enabled; set false only in tightly constrained environments.
translated: 控制日誌與遙測串接路徑中診斷檢測輸出的總開關。預設為啟用；僅在受到嚴格限制的環境中才設為 false。

text: Optional image input limits for this model, such as maximum side length, maximum pixels, and preferred compression side.
translated: 此模型的選填圖片輸入限制，例如最大邊長、像素數上限及偏好的壓縮邊長。

text: Connect to the gateway to see configured model providers.
translated: 連線至 Gateway 以查看已設定的模型供應商。
此工作階段目標無法使用。

text: OpenClaw couldn’t verify this tab’s address. Refresh to try again.
translated: OpenClaw 無法驗證此分頁的位址。請重新整理以重試。

text: Queue mode for active runs. Use "steer" to inject prompts into the active run, "followup" to run later, "collect" to batch compatible messages later, or "interrupt" to abort the active run before starting the newest prompt.
translated: 執行中作業的佇列模式。使用「steer」將提示注入執行中的作業、「followup」稍後執行、「collect」稍後批次處理相容的訊息，或使用「interrupt」在開始執行最新提示前中止執行中的作業。

text: Admin access is required to manage connectors.
translated: 需要管理員存取權限才能管理連接器。

text: Could not load advertised profiles: {error}. Check the gateway and retry.
translated: 無法載入已公布的設定檔: {error}. 請檢查 Gateway 並重試。

text: This model can chat, but it cannot use tools. Choose another model for files, commands, web, or media tasks.
translated: 此模型可以聊天，但無法使用工具。若要執行檔案、指令、網頁或媒體任務，請選擇其他模型。
正在安全地套用雲端編輯

text: Public — anyone can read without signing in.
translated: 公開 — 任何人都能閱讀，無須登入。

text: Skipped: the Gateway connection changed during the import
translated: 已略過: Gateway 連線在匯入期間發生變更

text: Explicit consent for anonymous feature statistics attached to the daily update check. Feature statistics are disabled by default and never include messages, credentials, or identifiers.
translated: 明確同意在每日更新檢查時附帶匿名功能統計資料。功能統計預設為停用，且絕不包含訊息、憑證或識別碼。

text: Sets the maximum bytes allowed per multimodal file before it is skipped during memory indexing. Use this to cap upload cost and indexing latency, or raise it for short high-quality audio clips.
translated: 設定每個多模態檔案允許的位元組數上限，超過此上限的檔案會在建立記憶索引時略過。可藉此限制上傳成本與索引延遲，或提高上限以處理高品質的短音訊片段。

text: Sign-in cancelled. No account was added by this attempt.
translated: 已取消登入。 此次嘗試未新增任何帳號。

text: Device access for notifications, capture, voice, and personal data.
translated: 通知、擷取、語音及個人資料的裝置存取權限。

text: Delete profile {profile}? New cloud sessions cannot use it after restart.
translated: 要刪除設定檔 {profile}? 重新啟動後, 新的雲端工作階段將無法使用此設定檔。

text: Discovery consent for guided setup: "full" scans silently while "guarded" asks before inspecting local applications.
translated: 引導式設定的探索同意模式："full" 會自動掃描而不詢問，"guarded" 則會在檢查本機應用程式前詢問。

text: Capture is starting. Refresh health to check the outcome.
translated: 正在啟動擷取。請重新整理健康狀態以查看結果。

text: Gateway connection replaced before {count} sessions were deleted. Try again.
translated: 在 {count} 個工作階段刪除前, Gateway 連線已被替換。 請重試。

text: A Gateway token cannot replace proxy authentication.
translated: Gateway 權杖無法取代 Proxy 驗證。
正在申請管理員存取權限…

text: The plugin that owns this tab is not active on the connected gateway, or it did not provide a panel.
translated: 此分頁所屬的外掛未在已連線的 Gateway 上啟用，或未提供面板。

text: Inline writes into the memory file; separate keeps a dedicated report file.
translated: 內嵌模式會寫入記憶檔案；獨立模式則保留專用的報告檔案。

text: Enables provider batch APIs for embedding jobs when supported (OpenAI/Gemini), improving throughput on larger index runs. Keep this enabled unless debugging provider batch failures or running very small workloads.
translated: 在供應商支援時（OpenAI/Gemini），啟用批次 API 來執行嵌入向量作業，以提升大型索引作業的處理量。除非正在偵錯供應商的批次作業失敗問題，或執行的工作負載非常小，否則請保持啟用。

text: I annotated the page at {url} (page-reported title: "{title}") — the attached screenshot shows my markup.
translated: 我已在 {url} 的頁面上加上註記 (頁面回報的標題: "{title}") — 附上的螢幕截圖顯示了我的標記。
正在載入執行階段工具目錄…

text: Shared default settings inherited by agents unless overridden per entry in agents.entries. Use defaults to enforce consistent baseline behavior and reduce duplicated per-agent configuration.
translated: 代理程式繼承的共用預設設定，除非在 agents.entries 的個別項目中覆寫。使用預設設定可確保一致的基本行為，並減少各代理程式的重複設定。

translated: 目前顯示此頁面的第一部分 (共 {count} 行).

translated: 麥克風輸入已停止。 請選擇可用的輸入裝置並重新開始。

translated: 請停止前景執行的 Gateway，執行 `openclaw update`，然後再次啟動。若要自動更新，請安裝受管理的 Gateway 服務。

text: Capture is in progress. Refresh to check for notes.
translated: 正在擷取中。 重新整理以查看筆記。

translated: 將瀏覽器路由固定至特定節點 ID 或名稱（選填）。

translated: 複製時對話已變更。請再試一次。

translated: 影片理解請求的預設逾時時間。處理較長的影片片段或使用較慢的本機分析模型時，請增加此時間。

translated: 已觀察到 GitHub {kind}. 中斷連線不會復原此效果。

translated: 請管理員核准待處理的 {command} 請求, 或選擇其他裝置。

translated: 討論串綁定工作階段建立、路由與傳遞的全域總開關。停用即可在全域關閉討論串綁定。

綁定工作階段群組範圍

text: Inbound webhook automation surface for mapping external events into wake or agent actions in OpenClaw. Keep this locked down with explicit token/session/agent controls before exposing it beyond trusted networks.
translated: 用於將外部事件對應至 OpenClaw 喚醒或代理程式動作的傳入 Webhook 自動化介面。在向信任網路以外開放此介面之前，請先透過明確的權杖、工作階段及代理程式控制措施，嚴格限制存取。

text: Authentication profile root used for multi-profile provider credentials and cooldown-based failover ordering. Keep profiles minimal and explicit so automatic failover behavior stays auditable.
translated: 驗證設定檔的根節點，用於管理多個設定檔的供應商憑證，以及依冷卻時間決定的容錯移轉順序。請讓設定檔保持精簡且明確，以便稽核自動容錯移轉行為。

text: Hostname patterns denied before DNS and allow rules on every web_fetch redirect. Supports exact hosts and "*.example.com" for subdomains only; add "example.com" separately to block the apex. Empty or unset adds no denials.
translated: 每次 web_fetch 重新導向時，會在 DNS 解析及允許規則之前先套用的主機名稱封鎖模式。支援完整主機名稱，以及僅比對子網域的 "*.example.com"；若要封鎖根網域，請另外加入 "example.com"。留空或未設定時，不會新增任何封鎖規則。
OpenAI Chat Completions 圖片限制

text: Controls post-compaction session memory reindex mode: "off", "async", or "await" (default: "async"). Use "await" for strongest freshness, "async" for lower compaction latency, and "off" only when session-memory sync is handled elsewhere.
translated: 控制壓縮後的工作階段記憶重新索引模式："off"、"async" 或 "await"（預設為 "async"）。使用 "await" 可最大程度確保資料即時更新，使用 "async" 可降低壓縮延遲；僅在其他機制已處理工作階段記憶同步時，才使用 "off"。

text: Diagnostics controls for targeted tracing, telemetry export, and cache inspection during debugging. Keep baseline diagnostics minimal in production and enable deeper signals only when investigating issues.
translated: 診斷控制項，用於偵錯期間的針對性追蹤、遙測匯出及快取檢查。在正式環境中，請將基本診斷維持在最低限度，僅在調查問題時啟用更深入的診斷訊號。
記憶搜尋結果數量上限

text: This execution path does not provide {label} evidence.
translated: 此執行路徑不提供{label}的佐證。

text: Restrict filesystem tools (read/write/edit/apply_patch) to the workspace directory (default: false).
translated: 將檔案系統工具（read/write/edit/apply_patch）限制在工作區目錄內使用（預設值：false）。

text: Destination identifier inside the selected channel when mapping replies should route to a fixed target. Verify provider-specific destination formats before enabling production mappings.
translated: 當映射回覆應傳送至固定目標時，所選頻道內的目的地識別碼。在正式環境中啟用映射前，請先確認各供應商專用的目的地格式。

text: Base URL for the provider endpoint used to serve model requests for that provider entry. Use HTTPS endpoints and keep URLs environment-specific through config templating where needed.
translated: 供應商端點的基底 URL，用於處理該供應商項目的模型請求。請使用 HTTPS 端點，並視需要透過設定範本，為不同環境指定各自的 URL。
Talk 即時前置音訊保留時間（毫秒）

text: Optional meeting URL for providers that join by URL instead of channel id. Use only trusted meeting links because auto-start may join and capture that meeting.
translated: 選填的會議 URL，適用於透過 URL 而非頻道 ID 加入會議的提供者。請僅使用可信任的會議連結，因為自動啟動可能會加入並擷取該會議的內容。

text: Your identity profile could not be loaded.
translated: 無法載入您的身分檔案。
進階: 代理程式 GitHub 覆寫設定

text: A human reviews requests beyond the session root.
translated: 超出工作階段根目錄範圍的請求由人工審查。

text: Overrides the auto-discovered sqlite-vec extension library path (`.dylib`, `.so`, or `.dll`). Use this when your runtime cannot find sqlite-vec automatically or you pin a known-good build.
translated: 覆寫自動偵測到的 sqlite-vec 擴充程式庫路徑（`.dylib`、`.so` 或 `.dll`）。當執行環境無法自動找到 sqlite-vec，或您要固定使用已知可正常運作的建置版本時，請使用此設定。

text: Remote gateway over SSH (tunnels the gateway port to localhost). Format: user@host or user@host:port.
translated: 透過 SSH 連線的遠端閘道（將閘道連接埠透過通道轉送至 localhost）。格式：user@host 或 user@host:port。

text: Control UI updated. Reload this page to continue the terminal action.
translated: Control UI 已更新。 請重新載入此頁面以繼續終端機操作。

text: This file does not exist yet. Saving will create it in the agent workspace.
translated: 此檔案尚不存在。儲存時會在代理程式工作區中建立此檔案。

text: This Gateway does not offer audit.run.inspect. Upgrade the Gateway, enable execution identity collection, and record a new run.
translated: 此 Gateway 不提供 audit.run.inspect。請升級 Gateway、啟用執行身分收集，並記錄新的執行作業。

text: OpenClaw Code Mode for this agent and exact provider/model: On forces it on, Off disables it, and Default inherits the agent activation setting, then the shared model override, then tools.codeMode.enabled. This does not change the selected runtime or Codex native Code Mode.
translated: 此代理與指定供應商／模型的 OpenClaw 程式碼模式：開啟會強制啟用，關閉會停用，預設則依序繼承代理啟用設定、共用模型覆寫設定，最後是 tools.codeMode.enabled。這不會變更所選的執行環境或 Codex 原生程式碼模式。

text: Channel/provider identifier this binding applies to, such as `telegram`, `discord`, or a plugin channel ID. Use the configured channel key exactly so binding evaluation works reliably.
translated: 此綁定適用的頻道／供應商識別碼，例如 `telegram`、`discord` 或外掛程式頻道 ID。請使用與設定完全一致的頻道鍵，以確保綁定判定可靠運作。

text: Matches a normalized session-key prefix after internal key normalization steps in policy consumers. Use this for general prefix controls, and prefer rawKeyPrefix when exact full-key matching is required.
translated: 在使用原則的元件完成內部鍵正規化步驟後，比對正規化的工作階段鍵前綴。一般前綴控制可使用此設定；若需要精確比對完整鍵，請優先使用 rawKeyPrefix。

text: Human mentions are not available in this mode. Remove the selected mentions or send from a normal chat.
translated: 此模式不支援提及人員。請移除所選的提及對象，或從一般聊天傳送。

text: Leave unchecked to keep native session catalogs off when you connect your AI provider. Existing installations are not changed.
translated: 保持未勾選，即可在連接 AI 供應商時維持關閉原生工作階段目錄。現有安裝不會變更。

text: Per-profile Chromium user data directory for existing-session attachment through Chrome DevTools MCP. Use this for Brave, Edge, Chromium, or non-default Chrome profiles when the built-in auto-connect path would pick the wrong browser data directory on the selected host or browser node. Paths starting with ~ expand to the OS home directory.
translated: 各設定檔的 Chromium 使用者資料目錄，用於透過 Chrome DevTools MCP 連接至現有工作階段。若內建的自動連線流程會在所選主機或瀏覽器節點上選到錯誤的瀏覽器資料目錄，可使用此設定指定 Brave、Edge、Chromium 或非預設 Chrome 設定檔的目錄。以 ~ 開頭的路徑會展開為作業系統的家目錄。

text: Controls whether mapping execution results are delivered back to a channel destination versus being processed silently. Disable delivery for background automations that should not post user-facing output.
translated: 控制是否將對應執行結果傳回目標頻道，而非靜默處理。對於不應發布使用者可見輸出的背景自動化作業，請停用傳送。

text: Use a local model service or prepare a private GGUF model on this Gateway.
translated: 使用本機模型服務，或在此 Gateway 上準備私有 GGUF 模型。

text: The Gateway could not return this diagnostic projection. No identity facts were inferred from Live activity.
translated: Gateway 無法傳回此診斷投影。未從即時活動推斷任何身分資訊。

text: The Gateway is restarting. This page disconnects and reconnects on its own. If it stays disconnected, run `openclaw triage` on the Gateway host to open a local coding agent for diagnosis and repair.
translated: Gateway 正在重新啟動。此頁面會自動中斷並重新連線。如果持續中斷連線，請在 Gateway 主機上執行 `openclaw triage`，開啟本機程式設計代理以進行診斷與修復。

text: Stops unfinished personal publication. Published work stays intact; revoke the app grant separately in GitHub settings.
translated: 停止尚未完成的個人發佈。已發佈的成果保持不變; 請另行前往 GitHub 設定撤銷應用程式授權。

text: This Gateway URL uses plaintext ws://. Use wss:// or Tailscale Serve, then create a new code for full access.
translated: 此 Gateway URL 使用明文 ws://。請使用 wss:// 或 Tailscale Serve，然後建立新設定碼以取得完整存取權限。

text: The processed avatar is larger than 512 KB.
translated: 處理後的頭像大於 512 KB.

text: Name, emoji, and avatar shown in chats and the sidebar.
translated: 顯示於聊天與側邊欄的名稱、表情符號及頭像。
隱藏 {session} 的 {count} 個子工作階段

text: Talk reasoning strategy: agent-consult for Gateway-mediated agent help, direct-tools for local tool calls, or none.
translated: Talk 推理策略：agent-consult 表示透過 Gateway 取得代理協助，direct-tools 表示呼叫本機工具，none 表示不使用。

text: Optional retention window in hours for persisted media handled by the general mtime sweep. Leave unset to disable that sweep, or set values like 24 (1 day) or 168 (7 days) to periodically remove older staged media. Managed outgoing media (chat-generated attachments) is excluded and follows its own SQLite- and transcript-aware retention.
translated: 由一般 mtime 清理作業處理的持久儲存媒體可選用的保留期限，以小時為單位。留空可停用該清理作業，或設為 24（1 天）、168（7 天）等數值，以定期移除較舊的暫存媒體。受管理的傳出媒體（聊天產生的附件）不在此範圍內，並遵循其專屬、會考量 SQLite 與對話記錄的保留機制。

text: Interrupted before the agent started it. It will not run automatically; copy it and send again.
translated: 已在代理程式開始執行前中斷。此項目不會自動執行; 請複製並重新傳送。

text: Explicitly allows this plugin to request api.runtime.llm.complete against a non-default agent id. Keep false unless the plugin is trusted for cross-agent model access.
translated: 明確允許此外掛程式以非預設代理 ID 請求 api.runtime.llm.complete。除非信任此外掛程式可跨代理存取模型，否則請維持 false。

text: Signal-specific OTLP/HTTP logs endpoint. When set, this overrides diagnostics.otel.endpoint and OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT for log export only.
translated: 專用於日誌訊號的 OTLP/HTTP 端點。設定後，僅在匯出日誌時覆寫 diagnostics.otel.endpoint 和 OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT。
自動化 Webhook SSRF 政策

text: Value for the Strict-Transport-Security response header. Set only on HTTPS origins that you fully control; use false to explicitly disable.
translated: Strict-Transport-Security 回應標頭的值。僅應在您完全控制的 HTTPS 來源上設定；使用 false 可明確停用。

text: Path published by Tailscale Serve/Funnel for Gmail callback forwarding when enabled. Keep it aligned with Gmail webhook config so requests reach the expected handler.
translated: 啟用後，由 Tailscale Serve/Funnel 發布、用於轉送 Gmail 回呼的路徑。請確保此路徑與 Gmail webhook 設定一致，讓請求能送達預期的處理常式。
Gateway 伺服器設定 (連接埠、驗證、繫結)

text: HTTPS URL to your profile picture
translated: 您個人檔案圖片的 HTTPS URL
輕輕地為這一天建立索引…

text: Max characters of each workspace bootstrap file injected into the system prompt before truncation (default: 20000).
translated: 每個工作區啟動檔案注入系統提示的字元數上限，超出部分將截斷（預設：20000）。

text: Config hash missing; refresh and retry.
translated: 缺少設定雜湊值; 請重新整理後再試。

text: Native CLI host unavailable. Check that the CLI is installed and the node is connected with its fresh-start command approved, then retry the catalog.
translated: 原生 CLI 主機無法使用。請確認已安裝 CLI，且節點已連線並獲准執行其 fresh-start 命令，然後重新載入目錄。

text: The feature setting could not be saved.

OpenClaw Code Mode for this exact provider/model: On forces it on, Off disables it, and Default inherits tools.codeMode.enabled. Agent-specific activation settings take precedence. This does not change the selected runtime or Codex native Code Mode.
translated: 此特定供應商／模型的 OpenClaw 程式碼模式：開啟會強制啟用，關閉會停用，預設則沿用 tools.codeMode.enabled。代理程式專屬的啟用設定具有優先權。這不會變更所選的執行環境或 Codex 原生程式碼模式。

text: Local callback server settings block for directly receiving Gmail notifications without a separate ingress layer. Enable only when this process should terminate webhook traffic itself.
translated: 本機回呼伺服器設定區塊，用於直接接收 Gmail 通知，無需獨立的流量入口層。僅在此程序應自行處理 webhook 傳入流量時啟用。

text: Use lightweight bootstrap context for this agent job.
translated: 為此代理程式作業使用精簡的啟動上下文。

text: Tool policy wrapper for spawned subagents to restrict or expand tool availability compared to parent defaults. Use this to keep delegated agent capabilities scoped to task intent.
translated: 針對衍生子代理程式的工具政策封裝，可在父代理程式預設值的基礎上限制或擴大工具可用範圍。使用此設定可將受委派代理程式的能力限制在任務所需範圍內。

text: Match rule object for deciding when a binding applies, including channel and optional account/peer constraints. Keep rules narrow to avoid accidental agent takeover across contexts.
translated: 用於判定何時套用綁定的比對規則物件，包含頻道及選用的帳號／對端限制條件。請縮小規則範圍，避免代理程式意外接管其他情境。

text: Enables text-command parsing in chat input in addition to native command surfaces where available. Keep this enabled for compatibility across channels that do not support native command registration.
translated: 除了可用的原生指令介面外，也啟用聊天輸入中的文字指令解析。請保持啟用，以相容於不支援原生指令註冊的各個頻道。

text: Optional Codex MCP tool approval mode for this server: "auto", "prompt", or "approve". Use only for MCP servers you intentionally trust.
translated: 此伺服器的選填 Codex MCP 工具核准模式："auto"、"prompt" 或 "approve"。僅適用於您明確信任的 MCP 伺服器。

text: Domain allowlist for native Codex web_search. On native-hosted-search turns, it also gates managed web_fetch; managed-provider turns are unchanged.
translated: 原生 Codex web_search 的網域允許清單。在使用原生託管搜尋的回合中，此清單也會限制受管理的 web_fetch；使用受管理供應商的回合則不受影響。

text: Handles short background tasks such as generated titles, progress narration, and session summaries.
translated: 處理簡短的背景工作，例如產生標題、描述進度及摘要工作階段。

text: OpenClaw could not reply. Try again.
translated: OpenClaw 無法回覆。 請再試一次。

text: OAuth credential ownership for this server. Omit this field or use "shared" for operator-managed credentials; use "per-requester" to let each authenticated sender connect their own account.
translated: 此伺服器的 OAuth 憑證歸屬。省略此欄位或使用 "shared"，即可使用由操作人員管理的憑證；使用 "per-requester" 則可讓每位已通過驗證的傳送者連結自己的帳戶。

text: Additional shared skill roots to scan at lowest precedence. Use this for sibling repos or shared skill packs that should be available without copying them into the OpenClaw workspace.
translated: 以最低優先順序掃描的額外共用技能根目錄。適用於同層儲存庫或共用技能套件，無須將其複製到 OpenClaw 工作區即可使用。

text: This connection has no personal profile; sign in through Cloudflare Access, Tailscale Serve, or a trusted proxy to set a name and avatar.
translated: 此連線沒有個人檔案；請透過 Cloudflare Access、Tailscale Serve 或受信任的代理伺服器登入，以設定名稱和頭像。
尚未設定 MCP 伺服器。

text: Explicit gateway-level tool allowlist when you want a narrow set of tools available at runtime. Use this for locked-down environments where tool scope must be tightly controlled.
translated: 明確指定的 Gateway 層級工具允許清單，適用於只希望在執行階段提供少量工具的情況。請用於必須嚴格控管工具範圍的受限環境。

text: Conversation identifier used with peer matching, such as a chat ID, channel ID, or group ID from the provider. Keep this exact to avoid silent non-matches.
translated: 用於對端比對的對話識別碼，例如供應商提供的聊天 ID、頻道 ID 或群組 ID。請確保此值完全正確，以免比對失敗卻未收到提示。

text: Controls whether this plugin may read raw conversation content from typed hooks such as `before_agent_run`, `before_model_resolve`, `before_agent_reply`, `llm_input`, `llm_output`, `before_agent_finalize`, and `agent_end`. Non-bundled plugins must opt in explicitly.
translated: 控制此外掛程式是否可透過 `before_agent_run`、`before_model_resolve`、`before_agent_reply`、`llm_input`、`llm_output`、`before_agent_finalize` 和 `agent_end` 等具型別掛鉤讀取原始對話內容。非隨附的外掛程式必須明確選擇啟用。
清除工作階段覆寫設定

text: Memory engine is Off. Choose an engine in Settings to enable dreaming.
translated: 記憶引擎已關閉。 請在設定中選擇引擎以啟用夢境功能。

text: A lobster beside the Discord mark on a lit seafloor pedestal
translated: 海底一座打著燈光的基座上，龍蝦位於 Discord 標誌旁

text: Enable embedded proactive auto-compaction (default: true). Set false to stop threshold-driven embedded compaction while preserving OpenClaw overflow recovery, preflight compaction, and manual /compact.
translated: 啟用內嵌的主動自動壓縮（預設：true）。設為 false 可停止由閾值觸發的內嵌壓縮，同時保留 OpenClaw 溢位復原、預檢壓縮及手動 /compact 功能。

text: Send or remove browser annotations first. Your draft is unchanged.
translated: 請先傳送或移除瀏覽器註解。 您的草稿未變更。
允許外掛程式覆寫 LLM 代理
已收到 · 等待工作區同步

text: Top-level binding rules for routing and persistent ACP conversation ownership. Use type=route for normal routing and type=acp for persistent ACP harness bindings.
translated: 用於路由與持久性 ACP 對話歸屬的頂層綁定規則。一般路由請使用 type=route，持久性 ACP 執行框架綁定請使用 type=acp。
插入已上傳檔案的路徑

text: Required role assigned to authenticated profiles without a valid explicit assignment whenever operator roles are configured. Its name must match a configured role definition.
translated: 設定操作員角色時，此為必要角色，會指派給未明確指派有效角色的已驗證個人資料。其名稱必須符合已設定的角色定義。

text: Preferred image resize side for balanced compression. Leave unset to use OpenClaw's conservative default.
translated: 調整圖片大小時偏好的邊長，以平衡壓縮效果。若不設定，則使用 OpenClaw 的保守預設值。
在工作樹中新增工作階段

text: Choose views for this browser window. Built-in views are always available.
translated: 選擇此瀏覽器視窗要使用的檢視。內建檢視一律可用。
工具允許清單新增項目

text: ACP backend override for this binding (falls back to agent runtime ACP backend, then global acp.backend).
translated: 此綁定的 ACP 後端覆寫設定（未設定時使用代理執行環境的 ACP 後端，再未設定則使用全域 acp.backend）。
舊版設定路由; 開啟外觀設定。
啟用 Gateway 節點 Skills

text: If set, timeout must be greater than 0 seconds.
translated: 若有設定，逾時時間必須大於 0 秒。
群組未提及的傳入訊息

text: Target size after disk-budget cleanup (high-water mark). Defaults to 80% of maxDiskBytes; set explicitly for tighter reclaim behavior on constrained disks. A value that resolves to zero falls back to the default; negative values are invalid. Disable the budget with maxDiskBytes instead.
translated: 磁碟預算清理後的目標大小（高水位標記）。預設為 maxDiskBytes 的 80%；若磁碟空間有限，可明確設定此值，以更嚴格地回收空間。解析結果為零時會回復為預設值；負值無效。如要停用預算限制，請改用 maxDiskBytes。

text: Enables durable automatic meeting notes, the transcripts agent tool, and configured auto-start sources. Default: true. Set false to disable persistence and the tool; explicit meeting transcribe mode retains its bounded live tail.
translated: 啟用可持久儲存的自動會議筆記、transcripts 代理工具，以及已設定的自動啟動來源。預設值：true。設為 false 可停用持久儲存與工具；明確指定的會議轉錄模式仍會保留有限範圍的最新即時內容。

text: Inject a message into the active run
translated: 將訊息插入目前的執行作業

text: Optional provider-specific `input_type` value for query-time memory embeddings. Use this with OpenAI-compatible asymmetric embedding endpoints that require a query label.

text: Enables summary quality audits and regeneration retries for safeguard compaction. Default: true in safeguard mode.
translated: 啟用防護式壓縮的摘要品質稽核與重新產生重試。預設值：防護模式下為 true。

text: Authorize GitHub without pasting a long-lived credential into the browser.
translated: 授權 GitHub, 無需將長效憑證貼入瀏覽器。
複製採用雲端版本的指令

text: Per-agent additive allowlist for tools on top of global and profile policy. Keep narrow to avoid accidental privilege expansion on specialized agents.
translated: 在全域及設定檔原則之外，為個別代理程式額外允許的工具清單。請將範圍限縮，以免意外擴大專用代理程式的權限。

text: Caps unarchived session entries (default 5000). Eligible durable overflow conversations are archived with their history; disposable automation entries are removed. Existing archives do not consume the cap. Protected active entries still count and can keep the store above the limit.
translated: 限制未封存的工作階段項目數（預設為 5000）。超出上限且符合條件的持久性對話會連同歷史記錄一起封存；一次性的自動化項目則會移除。現有封存不計入上限。受保護的活躍項目仍會計入，因此儲存區的項目數可能持續超出上限。
啟動情境每日記憶天數

text: Start the native CLI on the selected machine using its own account and configuration. This does not create an OpenClaw Chat.
translated: 使用所選機器本身的帳戶與設定，在該機器上啟動原生 CLI. 這不會建立 OpenClaw 聊天。

text: Session context changed while preparing the export. Refresh usage and try again.
translated: 準備匯出時，工作階段的上下文已變更。 請重新整理用量後再試一次。

text: Default heartbeat visibility settings for status messages emitted by providers/channels. Tune this globally to reduce noisy healthy-state updates while keeping alerts visible.
translated: 供應商或頻道發出的狀態訊息之預設心跳可見性設定。可全域調整此設定，減少正常狀態更新的干擾，同時保持警示可見。

text: Capability details must be available before you can approve this plugin.
translated: 必須先取得功能詳細資訊，才能核准此外掛程式。

text: The browser could not reach {host}. Check the address and transport before retrying credentials.
translated: 瀏覽器無法連線至 {host}。請先檢查位址與傳輸方式，再重試驗證憑證。
依類型分類的詞元用量

text: Show a floating composer for quick messages, summoned with a global shortcut.
translated: 顯示浮動訊息輸入框，透過全域快捷鍵叫出，即可快速傳送訊息。
將 {count} 個項目標示為已讀

text: Runtime-owned first-turn prelude for bare "/new" and "/reset". Use this to control whether recent daily memory files are preloaded into the first prompt instead of asking the model to decide what to read.
translated: 由執行階段管理的首輪前置內容，適用於不帶參數的 "/new" 和 "/reset"。使用此設定可控制是否將最近的每日記憶檔案預先載入第一個提示，而非讓模型自行決定要讀取哪些內容。

text: Allowed MIME types for `image_url` parts (case-insensitive list).
translated: `image_url` 部分允許的 MIME 類型（清單不區分大小寫）。

text: Transform configuration block defining module/export preprocessing before mapping action handling. Use transforms only from reviewed code paths and keep behavior deterministic for repeatable automation.
translated: 轉換設定區塊，定義在處理映射動作前用於前置處理的模組及匯出項目。請僅使用經過審查的程式碼路徑中的轉換，並確保行為具有確定性，以實現可重複的自動化。

text: GitHub CLI submission was unavailable. Use the prefilled issue link.
translated: 無法透過 GitHub CLI 提交。請使用已預填內容的議題連結。

text: Allow sends across different providers (default: false).
translated: 允許跨不同提供者傳送訊息（預設值：false）。

text: Mapping action type: "wake" triggers agent wake flow, while "agent" sends directly to agent handling. Use "agent" for immediate execution and "wake" when heartbeat-driven processing is preferred.
translated: 對應動作類型："wake" 會觸發代理程式喚醒流程，而 "agent" 會直接交由代理程式處理。需要立即執行時請使用 "agent"；偏好由心跳驅動處理時，請使用 "wake"。

text: Sets the default for new sessions. Auto starts in fast mode and returns to standard mode after the model's configured interval; On and Off keep that behavior fixed.
translated: 設定新工作階段的預設值。 自動模式會以快速模式啟動，並在模型設定的時間間隔後返回標準模式; 開啟和關閉則會維持固定模式。

text: Periodically check for new versions and show update notices.
translated: 定期檢查新版本並顯示更新通知。

text: Environment import and override settings used to supply runtime variables to the gateway process. Use this section to control shell-env loading and explicit variable injection behavior.
translated: 環境匯入與覆寫設定，用於向 Gateway 程序提供執行階段變數。使用此區段來控制 Shell 環境載入及明確指定的變數注入行為。
WhatsApp 已連結並可供使用。

text: Request timed out after 30 seconds; the server may still have applied the change — check the profile before retrying.
translated: 請求在 30 秒後逾時; 伺服器可能仍已套用變更 — 重試前請先檢查個人檔案。

text: Changes to settings are disabled while the Gateway is reconnecting.
translated: Gateway 重新連線期間無法變更設定。

text: {percent}% used · {free} free. Delete unneeded files or stop the cloud worker before large writes.
translated: 已使用 {percent}% · 可用空間 {free}。進行大量寫入前，請刪除不需要的檔案或停止雲端工作程序。

text: Dreaming runs as one managed automation across every agent workspace, so these settings are global. They are owned by the {plugin} plugin.
translated: 夢境作業以單一受管理的自動化作業形式，在所有代理程式工作區中執行，因此這些設定適用於全域。這些設定由 {plugin} 外掛程式管理。

text: Browsing only. Channel setup requires operator.admin access.
translated: 僅供瀏覽。設定頻道需要 operator.admin 存取權限。

text: Skill selections updated for the next turn. An active turn keeps its current revision.
translated: 技能選取項目已更新, 將於下一回合生效。 進行中的回合會保留目前的修訂版本。

text: Browsing only. Worktree changes require operator.admin access.
translated: 僅供瀏覽。 變更工作樹需要 operator.admin 存取權限。
選擇此工作階段的權限。

text: The model could not be activated.

Require explicit approval for interpreter inline-eval forms such as `python -c`, `node -e`, `ruby -e`, or `osascript -e`. Prevents silent allowlist reuse and downgrades allow-always to ask-each-time for those forms.
translated: 要求明確核准直譯器的行內求值形式，例如 `python -c`、`node -e`、`ruby -e` 或 `osascript -e`。防止在未提示的情況下沿用允許清單，並將這些形式的「一律允許」降為「每次詢問」。
模型設定需要 operator.admin 存取權限。

text: Recovery needs a reload. Unsaved starts will be lost.
translated: 需要重新載入才能復原。尚未儲存的啟動設定將會遺失。

text: Optional Gmail label filter limiting which labeled messages trigger hook events. Keep filters narrow to avoid flooding automations with unrelated inbox traffic.
translated: 選用的 Gmail 標籤篩選器，用於限制哪些帶有標籤的郵件會觸發掛鉤事件。請縮小篩選範圍，避免大量無關的收件匣郵件湧入自動化流程。
操作員角色權限範圍上限
工作階段重設觸發條件
代理模型執行環境 ID

text: Model Provider Request Auth Header Value
translated: 模型供應商請求驗證標頭值

text: OpenClaw learns from completed work and improves reusable skills in the background. Reviews use your configured model.
translated: OpenClaw 會從已完成的工作中學習，並在背景改善可重複使用的技能。審查會使用你設定的模型。

text: Cache-trace logging settings for observing cache decisions and payload context in embedded runs. Enable this temporarily for debugging and disable afterward to reduce sensitive log footprint.
translated: 快取追蹤記錄設定，用於觀察嵌入式執行期間的快取決策及承載資料脈絡。請在偵錯時暫時啟用，並在完成後停用，以減少敏感資訊的記錄量。
正在重新啟動工作階段…

text: Group-message handling controls including mention triggers and history window sizing. Keep mention patterns narrow so group channels do not trigger on every message.
translated: 群組訊息處理控制項，包括提及觸發條件與歷史記錄視窗大小。請縮小提及比對模式的範圍，以免群組頻道中的每則訊息都觸發處理。

text: Overrides the embedding API endpoint, such as an OpenAI-compatible proxy or custom Gemini base URL. Use this only when routing through your own gateway or vendor endpoint; keep provider defaults otherwise.
translated: 覆寫嵌入向量 API 端點，例如相容於 OpenAI 的代理伺服器或自訂 Gemini 基底 URL。僅在透過自己的閘道或供應商端點路由請求時使用此設定；否則請保留供應商預設值。

text: The server was saved disabled globally, but enabling it for this session failed: {error}
translated: 伺服器已儲存為全域停用，但無法在此工作階段啟用：{error}

text: Could not load the pairing dialog. Check your connection and try again.
translated: 無法載入配對對話方塊。請檢查連線後再試一次。

text: Groups plugin-approval forwarding behavior including enablement, routing mode, filters, and explicit targets. Independent of exec approval forwarding. Configure here when plugin approval prompts must reach operational channels.
translated: 集中管理外掛程式核准的轉送行為，包括啟用狀態、路由模式、篩選條件及明確指定的目標。此設定獨立於執行核准轉送。當外掛程式核准提示必須送達作業頻道時，請在此設定。

text: Show native assistant conversations from this Gateway host in OpenClaw. This is discovery, not an import or copy.
translated: 在 OpenClaw 中顯示此 Gateway 主機上的原生助理對話。這是探索功能，不會匯入或複製對話。

text: Enter a URL for HTTP transports or a valid command line for stdio.
translated: 請為 HTTP 傳輸輸入 URL，或為 stdio 輸入有效的命令列。
正在準備語音工作階段...

text: Internal hook runtime settings for bundled/custom event handlers loaded from module paths. Use this for trusted in-process automations and keep handler loading tightly scoped.
translated: 內部掛鉤的執行階段設定，適用於從模組路徑載入的內建或自訂事件處理常式。請用於受信任的處理程序內自動化作業，並嚴格限制處理常式的載入範圍。

text: …plus {count} more marked region(s), all visible in the screenshot.
translated: …另有 {count} 個標記區域，皆可在螢幕截圖中看到。

text: Could not verify whether pairing completed.
translated: 無法確認配對是否完成。

text: Enable metrics signal export to the configured OpenTelemetry collector endpoint. Keep enabled for runtime health dashboards, and disable only if metric volume must be minimized.
translated: 啟用指標訊號匯出至已設定的 OpenTelemetry 收集器端點。若需使用執行階段健康狀態儀表板，請保持啟用；僅在必須盡量減少指標資料量時停用。

text: Default max characters retained from AGENTS.md during post-compaction context refresh injection. Lower this to make compaction recovery cheaper, or raise it for agents that depend on longer startup guidance.
translated: 壓縮後重新整理上下文並注入內容時，預設從 AGENTS.md 保留的字元數上限。降低此值可減少壓縮後復原的成本；若代理程式依賴較長的啟動指引，則可提高此值。

text: Email addresses connected to this profile.
translated: 與此個人檔案連結的電子郵件地址。

text: Command owners can run privileged commands and approve dangerous actions. This option is only available while no owner is configured.
translated: 指令擁有者可以執行特權指令並核准危險操作。此選項僅在尚未設定擁有者時可用。
記憶搜尋文件輸入類型
{days} 天內共有 {candidates} 個候選項目

text: Model Provider Request TLS Skip Verify
translated: 模型供應商請求 TLS 略過驗證
已移除 {removed} 筆重複的夢境記錄。

text: Node browser routing ("auto" = pick single connected browser node, "manual" = require node param, "off" = disable).
translated: 節點瀏覽器路由（"auto" = 選取單一已連線的瀏覽器節點，"manual" = 必須提供節點參數，"off" = 停用）。
執行安全二進位檔設定檔
掛鉤對應工作階段模式

text: macOS access for notifications, capture, voice, and device context.
translated: 通知、擷取、語音及裝置情境資訊所需的 macOS 存取權限。

text: Overrides silent-reply policy for one resolved delivery surface. Unset fields inherit agents.defaults.silentReply; use narrow surface ids so internal or group-specific behavior does not spill into other destinations.
translated: 覆寫單一解析後傳遞介面的靜默回覆政策。未設定的欄位會繼承 agents.defaults.silentReply；請使用範圍明確的介面 ID，避免內部或特定群組的行為影響其他目的地。

text: Named MCP server definitions. OpenClaw stores them in its own config and runtime adapters decide which transports are supported at execution time.
translated: 具名的 MCP 伺服器定義。OpenClaw 會將其儲存在自身的設定中，由執行階段配接器在執行時決定支援哪些傳輸方式。

text: Browser Allow IPv6 Unique Local Range
translated: 瀏覽器允許 IPv6 唯一本機位址範圍
此 Gateway 需要其權杖

text: Crash alerts explained and triaged the moment they fire.
translated: 當機警示一觸發，立即解讀並分類處理。

text: Optional PDF model (provider/model) for the PDF analysis tool. Defaults to imageModel, then session model.
translated: PDF 分析工具使用的選用 PDF 模型（provider/model）。預設使用 imageModel，其次使用工作階段模型。
執行安全二進位檔信任目錄

text: The conversation context resets. Your dashboard stays.
translated: 對話脈絡將重設。 您的儀表板將保留。

text: Enable automatic link understanding pre-processing so URLs can be summarized before agent reasoning. Keep enabled for richer context, and disable when strict minimal processing is required.
translated: 啟用自動連結理解前置處理，以便在代理推理前摘要網址內容。保持啟用可提供更豐富的上下文；若需嚴格限制為最低限度的處理，請停用此功能。
來源代理 / 工作階段

text: Live stocks and crypto with price alerts and daily digests.
translated: 即時股票與加密貨幣行情，搭配價格警示與每日摘要。

text: This is a subagent of {parent}. Continue the conversation in its parent session.
translated: 這是 {parent} 的子代理。請在其上層工作階段中繼續對話。

text: Gateway connection replaced before "{session}" was deleted. Try again.
translated: 在 "{session}" 刪除前, Gateway 連線已被替換。 請重試。
模型圖片位元組數上限

text: This update attempt was already reported.
Start typing to pick a known model, or enter a custom one. Routine jobs (summaries, triage, classification) run well on a lighter model — cheaper and faster than your default.
translated: 開始輸入以選取已知模型，或輸入自訂模型。例行作業 (摘要、分流、分類) 使用輕量模型即可順利執行 — 比預設模型更省錢、更快速。

text: The account identity could not be verified. Sign in again with your own account.
translated: 無法驗證帳號身分。 請使用您自己的帳號重新登入。

text: mDNS discovery configuration group for local network advertisement and discovery behavior tuning. Keep minimal mode for routine LAN discovery unless extra metadata is required.
translated: mDNS 探索設定群組，用於調整區域網路公告和探索行為。除非需要額外的中繼資料，否則一般區域網路探索請維持最小模式。

text: How often an entry must be recalled before it can be promoted.
translated: 項目必須被回憶多少次才能提升為記憶。

text: Maximum number of memory hits returned from search before downstream reranking and prompt injection. Raise for broader recall, or lower for tighter prompts and faster responses.
translated: 在後續重新排序及注入提示之前，搜尋傳回的記憶命中結果數量上限。提高此值可擴大召回範圍，降低則可精簡提示並加快回應。

text: Update the Control UI session observer
translated: 更新 Control UI 工作階段觀察器

text: Per-plugin environment variable map injected for that plugin runtime context only. Use this to scope provider credentials to one plugin instead of sharing global process environment.
translated: 個別外掛程式的環境變數對應表，僅注入該外掛程式的執行環境。可用於將供應商憑證的使用範圍限定於單一外掛程式，而非共用全域處理程序環境。
具有已儲存儀表板的任務。

text: Optional custom base HTTPS URL for the external APNs relay service used by official App Store iOS builds. Keep this aligned with the relay URL baked into the iOS build so registration and send traffic hit the same deployment.
translated: 官方 App Store iOS 版本所使用的外部 APNs 轉送服務的選用自訂基底 HTTPS URL。請讓此 URL 與 iOS 版本內建的轉送服務 URL 保持一致，確保註冊與傳送流量都連到同一個部署。
可驗證的識別碼 (例如 you@domain.com)

text: Show it again in Settings > Appearance > Sidebar.
translated: 在設定 > 外觀 > 側邊欄中重新顯示。

text: Workshop imports support UTF-8 text files. Keep executable and binary assets in the file-authored workspace workflow.
translated: Workshop 匯入支援 UTF-8 文字檔案。可執行檔與二進位資源請繼續透過以檔案編寫的工作區流程管理。

text: Allow notifications in this site's browser permissions.
translated: 請在此網站的瀏覽器權限設定中允許通知。

text: Gateway operation mode: "local" runs channels and agent runtime on this host, while "remote" connects through remote transport. Keep "local" unless you intentionally run a split remote gateway topology.
translated: Gateway 運作模式："local" 在此主機上執行頻道與代理程式執行環境，而 "remote" 則透過遠端傳輸連線。除非您刻意採用分離式遠端 Gateway 拓撲，否則請保留 "local"。
允許外掛程式覆寫子代理程式模型

text: Provides channel-specific reset overrides keyed by provider/channel id for fine-grained behavior control. Use this only when one channel needs exceptional reset behavior beyond type-level policies.
translated: 以供應商／頻道 ID 為索引鍵，提供個別頻道的重設覆寫設定，以精細控制行為。僅在某個頻道需要不同於類型層級原則的特殊重設行為時使用。

text: Speech-to-text may send audio to your configured transcription provider and incur provider usage. This library does not store or play raw audio.
translated: 語音轉文字可能會將音訊傳送至您設定的轉錄供應商，並產生供應商用量。本程式庫不會儲存或播放原始音訊。
尚未設定任何 MCP 伺服器。

text: Id of a registered compaction provider plugin used for summarization. When set and the provider is registered, its summarize() method is called instead of the built-in summarizeInStages pipeline. Falls back to built-in on provider failure. Leave unset to use the default built-in summarization.
translated: 用於產生摘要的已註冊壓縮提供者外掛程式 ID。設定此值且提供者已註冊時，會呼叫其 summarize() 方法，而非內建的 summarizeInStages 處理流程。提供者失敗時，會回退至內建機制。保持未設定即可使用預設的內建摘要功能。

text: Private key paired with request.proxy.tls.cert for proxy mutual TLS.
translated: 與 request.proxy.tls.cert 配對的私密金鑰，用於代理伺服器的雙向 TLS。
另有 {count} 個作用中的群組

text: Optional provider/model or configured bare alias used only for compaction summarization. Bare aliases resolve before dispatch; a configured literal model ID wins if it collides with an alias. Leave unset to keep using the primary agent model.
translated: 選用的供應商／模型或已設定的單獨別名，僅用於壓縮摘要。單獨別名會在派送前解析；若已設定的模型 ID 字面值與別名衝突，則以該模型 ID 為優先。保持未設定即可繼續使用主要代理程式模型。
代理程式預設快速模式

text: Exact MCP tool names or simple '*' globs to expose from this server. When omitted, all server tools remain eligible unless excluded.
translated: 要從此伺服器公開的 MCP 工具完整名稱，或使用 '*' 的簡單萬用字元模式。省略時，所有伺服器工具皆可使用，除非已被排除。

text: Check the transcript before relying on decisions or action items.
translated: 依據決策或待辦事項採取行動前，請先核對逐字稿。

text: Profile + per-tool overrides for this agent.
translated: 此代理程式的設定檔 + 個別工具覆寫設定。

text: Binary attachment. Its original bytes are preserved when you save.
translated: 二進位附件。 儲存時會保留其原始位元組。

text: Dependency install failed. Fix the install error and retry.
translated: 相依套件安裝失敗。 請修正安裝錯誤並重試。

text: Treat replies to the bot's own messages as implicit mentions by default. Defaults to true for backward compatibility.
translated: 預設將對機器人自身訊息的回覆視為隱含提及。為維持向後相容性，預設值為 true。

text: The Gateway is likely being accessed through a proxy or tunnel that exposes only its main port. Open this URL from a browser on the Gateway host.

translated: 透過查詢參數路由的 Gateway URL 無法建立不含憑證的接續命令，因為驗證機制和已儲存的裝置範圍不會識別查詢參數。請使用已手動驗證的 CLI 目標，或已設定且不含查詢參數的 Gateway URL。

text: CDP/DevTools endpoint URL used to attach to an externally managed browser instance. Use this for centralized browser hosts, tunnels, or existing-session attachment, and keep URL access restricted to trusted network paths.
translated: 用於連接外部管理之瀏覽器執行個體的 CDP/DevTools 端點 URL。適用於集中式瀏覽器主機、通道或現有工作階段連接，並請將 URL 存取限制在受信任的網路路徑內。
允許跨情境操作（跨提供者）

text: Choose a provider and verify the model OpenClaw will use.
translated: 選擇供應商並驗證 OpenClaw 將使用的模型。

text: Release channel, automatic updates, and current update status.
translated: 發行通道、自動更新和目前的更新狀態。

text: Completed, but result delivery is blocked.
translated: 已完成, 但結果傳送受阻。

text: No microphone found. Plug one in and it appears here.
translated: 找不到麥克風。 接上麥克風後, 就會顯示在這裡。

text: Another managed update is already running. Wait for it to complete, then refresh update status.
translated: 另一項受管理的更新正在執行中。請等待其完成，再重新整理更新狀態。
網頁擷取 SSRF 政策

text: DM session scoping: "main" keeps continuity, while "per-peer", "per-channel-peer", and "per-account-channel-peer" increase isolation. Use isolated modes for shared inboxes or multi-account deployments.
translated: 私訊工作階段的範圍設定："main" 維持連續性，而 "per-peer"、"per-channel-peer" 和 "per-account-channel-peer" 則提高隔離程度。共用收件匣或多帳號部署請使用隔離模式。

text: Defines optional rule match conditions that can combine channel, chatType, and key-prefix constraints. Keep matches narrow so policy intent stays readable and debugging remains straightforward.
translated: 定義選用的規則比對條件，可結合 channel、chatType 和鍵前綴限制。請縮小比對範圍，讓原則意圖清楚易懂，並方便偵錯。
Gateway 節點配對自動核准 CIDR

text: Setup could not finish. Install the OpenClaw CLI on this Mac and run openclaw browser extension install for details.
translated: 無法完成設定。請在這部 Mac 上安裝 OpenClaw CLI，並執行 openclaw browser extension install 以取得詳細資訊。
個人檔案已發布至中繼伺服器。

text: When true, fetch and include email body content for downstream mapping/agent processing. Keep false unless body text is required, because this increases payload size and sensitivity.
translated: 設為 true 時，擷取並包含電子郵件內文，以供下游對應或代理處理。除非需要內文，否則請保持 false，因為這會增加酬載大小及資料敏感性。

text: Maximum number of PDF pages to process for the PDF tool (default: 20).
translated: PDF 工具可處理的 PDF 頁數上限（預設：20）。

text: Optional per-agent overrides for skills subsystem budgets. Use this when an agent needs a different skills prompt budget without introducing a second generic context-limits path.
translated: 個別代理程式的技能子系統額度選用覆寫設定。當代理程式需要不同的技能提示額度，且不想引入第二條通用上下文限制設定路徑時，可使用此設定。
已從 {target} 程式庫移除 {slug} (擁有者: {owner})。

text: Linux only. Warm a direct or coordinator-backed AWS or Azure worker, or a coordinator-backed Hetzner worker, with node-carried Browser and Terminal access. Existing workers must be reprovisioned after this changes.
translated: 僅限 Linux。預先啟動直接連線或由協調器支援的 AWS 或 Azure 工作節點，或由協調器支援的 Hetzner 工作節點，並透過節點提供瀏覽器和終端機存取功能。變更此設定後，必須重新佈建現有工作節點。

text: Agent that owns retired main-agent rows or unscoped rows in a fixed legacy session store after default-marker retirement. Written automatically during upgrade when the former owner was not main or the sole agent.
translated: 預設標記停用後，擁有已停用的 main-agent 資料列，或固定舊版工作階段儲存區中未限定範圍資料列的代理程式。若原擁有者不是 main，也不是唯一的代理程式，則會在升級期間自動寫入。
切換 Gateway 密鑰顯示狀態

text: Enables OpenTelemetry export pipeline for traces, metrics, and logs based on configured endpoint/protocol settings. Keep disabled unless your collector endpoint and auth are fully configured.
translated: 根據已設定的端點與通訊協定，啟用 OpenTelemetry 的追蹤、指標和日誌匯出管線。除非已完整設定收集器端點與驗證資訊，否則請保持停用。
OpenAI Chat Completions 圖片逾時時間（毫秒）

text: Guardian is reviewing this action before it can continue.
translated: Guardian 正在審查此動作，完成後才能繼續。

text: This external session source is view-only.
translated: 此外部工作階段來源僅供檢視。

text: Keep typing to find more people.
translated: 繼續輸入以尋找更多人員。

text: That file already exists. Select it to edit its contents.
translated: 該檔案已存在。 請選取該檔案以編輯其內容。

text: Cannot safely insert the uploaded native file path
translated: 無法安全地插入已上傳檔案的原生路徑
Gmail 掛鉤 Pub/Sub 主題

text: Per-agent message guard for sending to other conversations on the same provider. Set false for current-conversation-only public agents.
translated: 個別代理向同一供應商上的其他對話傳送訊息時的防護設定。對於僅限在目前對話中傳訊的公開代理，請設為 false。

text: Annotation added to the chat composer.
translated: 註記已加入聊天輸入框。

text: Core transcript capture settings for meeting notes, recording-capable agent tools, and configured live meeting auto-start sources. Meeting plugins capture durable notes by default; set enabled to false to opt out globally.
translated: 用於會議筆記、具備錄製功能的代理工具，以及已設定的即時會議自動啟動來源的核心逐字稿擷取設定。會議外掛程式預設會擷取並永久保存筆記；將 enabled 設為 false 即可全域停用。
Gmail 掛鉤伺服器連接埠

text: Tailscale publish mode: "off", "serve", or "funnel" for private or public exposure paths. Use "serve" for tailnet-only access and "funnel" only when public internet reachability is required.
translated: Tailscale 發布模式："off"、"serve" 或 "funnel"，用於設定私人或公開的存取路徑。僅限 tailnet 存取時請使用 "serve"；只有需要從公用網際網路存取時，才使用 "funnel"。

text: Access calendar events when requested by the agent.
translated: 在代理程式要求時存取行事曆活動。

text: Ask anything, show what you're making, and find out what everyone else is building.
translated: 隨時提問、展示你的作品，並看看其他人正在打造什麼。

text: Run /pair qr again to generate a fresh setup code.
translated: 請再次執行 /pair qr 以產生新的設定碼。

text: This session's workspace is not a git checkout.
translated: 此工作階段的工作區不是 git 簽出目錄。

text: Configuration reload stopped — ask me what happened
translated: 設定重新載入已停止 — 問我發生了什麼事

text: This code authorizes only the selected identity scope.
translated: 此驗證碼僅授權所選的身分範圍。

text: ISO timestamp recording when the operator accepted or declined anonymous feature statistics. Prevents the setup wizard from asking again.
translated: 記錄操作者接受或拒絕匿名功能統計資料的 ISO 時間戳記。可避免設定精靈再次詢問。

text: Optional passphrase used to decrypt request.proxy.tls.key.
translated: 用於解密 request.proxy.tls.key 的選用密碼片語。
代理內嵌 OpenClaw 執行契約

text: Durable multi-agent ownership generation marker. "explicit" means ambient channels, heartbeat, system-agent consults, Talk, cron, and bare CLI operations must resolve a surface-specific owner or fail closed. OpenClaw stamps this automatically when creating or migrating a fleet; omit it for a sole agent.
translated: 持久化的多代理擁有權世代標記。"explicit" 表示背景頻道、心跳、系統代理諮詢、Talk、cron 及未指定代理的 CLI 操作，都必須解析出特定介面的擁有者，否則拒絕執行。OpenClaw 會在建立或遷移代理群時自動寫入此標記；僅有單一代理時請省略。

text: Realtime voice: provider, model, and speaker voice.
translated: 即時語音：供應商、模型和說話聲音。

text: App behavior and capabilities on this device.
translated: 此裝置上的應用程式行為與功能。

text: Global session routing, reset, delivery policy, and maintenance controls for conversation history behavior. Keep defaults unless you need stricter isolation, retention, or delivery constraints.
translated: 用於控制對話記錄行為的全域工作階段路由、重設、傳遞政策與維護設定。除非需要更嚴格的隔離、保留或傳遞限制，否則請保留預設值。
一鍵設定 MCP 伺服器
允許跨情境傳送（同一供應商）
每個群集群組的子代理總數

text: Copy cookies from a Chrome-family profile into an isolated managed profile.
translated: 將 Cookie 從 Chrome 系列瀏覽器的設定檔複製到隔離的受管理設定檔。

text: Controls whether paired nodes may publish agent-visible plugin tool descriptors.
translated: 控制已配對的節點是否可發布代理可見的外掛工具描述資訊。
您有尚未儲存的設定變更。

text: Compaction strategy mode: "safeguard" (the effective default when unset) applies guardrails to preserve recent context, while "default" uses baseline summarization without them. Set "default" only if safeguard summarization causes problems for your provider.
translated: 壓縮策略模式："safeguard"（未設定時實際採用的預設值）會套用防護機制以保留近期上下文，而 "default" 則使用不含這些防護機制的基本摘要方式。只有在 safeguard 摘要方式對您的供應商造成問題時，才設定為 "default"。

text: Deliver to this browser or app
translated: 傳送至此瀏覽器或應用程式

text: Could not apply change. Check your connection and try again.
translated: 無法套用變更。 請檢查連線後再試一次。
待處理的短期記憶項目
依提供者設定的工具政策
已回填 {count} 筆夢境日記記錄。

text: Group created, but the move was skipped because the list changed. Move from the row menu.
translated: 群組已建立，但由於清單已變更，已略過移動操作。 請從該列的選單進行移動。
多個執行個體符合此執行參照

text: Optional. Leave blank to use the Gateway host timezone, or enter any valid IANA timezone.
translated: 選填。 留空以使用 Gateway 主機的時區, 或輸入任何有效的 IANA 時區。
無法載入進行中的工作階段。
網頁擷取下載大小上限（位元組）

text: All skills are enabled. Disabling any skill will create a per-agent allowlist.
translated: 所有技能皆已啟用。停用任何技能都會為此代理程式建立專屬的允許清單。

text: Full content is unavailable because this transcript entry does not have a visible WebChat projection.
translated: 無法提供完整內容，因為此對話記錄項目沒有可見的 WebChat 呈現版本。

text: Installing this plugin restarts the Gateway immediately and interrupts active sessions.
translated: 安裝此外掛會立即重新啟動 Gateway，並中斷進行中的工作階段。

text: Disabled {name}. A Gateway restart is required to apply the change.
translated: 已停用 {name}. 必須重新啟動 Gateway 才能套用變更。
代理程式 Skills 限制

text: Added {name}. New agent sessions can use it right away.
translated: 已新增 {name}. 新的代理工作階段可立即使用。
啟用 Gateway 節點外掛工具

text: Per-agent override for CDP source CIDR allowlist.
translated: 各代理程式的 CDP 來源 CIDR 允許清單覆寫設定。

text: Global message action allowlist for the message tool. Use only when the whole runtime should expose and accept a reduced action set; prefer per-agent allowlists for public or sandboxed agents.
translated: 訊息工具的全域訊息動作允許清單。僅在整個執行環境都應提供並接受較少的動作時使用；對於公開或在沙箱中執行的代理程式，建議優先使用個別代理程式的允許清單。

text: Manage macOS access, location, and computer presence.
translated: 管理 macOS 存取權限、位置與電腦在線狀態。

text: HTTP endpoint feature toggles under the gateway API surface for compatibility routes and optional integrations. Enable endpoints intentionally and monitor access patterns after rollout.
translated: Gateway API 範圍內的 HTTP 端點功能開關，用於相容性路由和選用整合。請審慎啟用端點，並在推出後監控存取模式。

text: Copy this command to continue the current session. It is safe to paste in common terminals and shells.
translated: 複製此命令以繼續目前的工作階段。可安全地貼上至常見的終端機和 shell。
代理跨情境傳訊（同一供應商）

text: Restart or reload the Gateway after changing allowed origins.
translated: 變更允許的來源後，請重新啟動或重新載入 Gateway。

text: Capture the screen for context or screenshots.
translated: 擷取螢幕以提供情境資訊或截圖。

text: Search provider id. Auto-detected from available API keys if omitted.
translated: 搜尋供應商 ID。若省略，則根據可用的 API 金鑰自動偵測。

text: Enter a URL and press Enter
Wait for your identity profile to load. If it does not appear, use Refresh or Set identity above to retry.
translated: 請等待您的身分資料載入。如果未顯示，請使用上方的「重新整理」或「設定身分」重試。
已封存 {count} 個工作階段

text: Milliseconds of user silence before Talk mode finalizes and sends the current transcript. Leave unset to keep the platform default pause window (700 ms on macOS and Android, 900 ms on iOS).
translated: 使用者保持靜音多少毫秒後，Talk 模式會完成並傳送目前的轉錄文字。留空可保留平台預設的停頓時間（macOS 和 Android 為 700 毫秒，iOS 為 900 毫秒）。

text: The Gateway cannot wake an offline Windows device. Start the machine or restore its network connection.
translated: Gateway 無法喚醒離線的 Windows 裝置。請啟動該電腦或恢復其網路連線。

text: Waiting to sync through the gateway.
translated: 正在等待透過 Gateway 同步。
程式碼模式快照大小上限
討論串綁定閒置逾時（小時）

text: Glanceable chats and quick replies from your wrist.
translated: 在手腕上輕鬆查看聊天並快速回覆。

text: No MCP servers configured yet. Add one here or pick a connector from Discover.
translated: 尚未設定任何 MCP 伺服器。 請在此新增，或從「探索」中選擇連接器。

text: The initial message is unresolved. Reconnect if needed, then review it before sending another message.
translated: 初始訊息尚未處理完成。 如有需要，請重新連線，並在傳送其他訊息前檢查初始訊息。

text: Minimum relevance score threshold for including memory results in final recall output. Increase to reduce weak/noisy matches, or lower when you need more permissive retrieval.
translated: 將記憶結果納入最終召回輸出所需的最低相關性分數門檻。提高此值可減少相關性低或含雜訊的相符結果；需要較寬鬆的檢索條件時，則可降低此值。

text: Occupancy mode chooses session IDs automatically and ignores this saved value.
translated: 佔用模式會自動選擇工作階段 ID，並忽略此已儲存的值。
多帳號設定使用的帳號 ID
啟動載入總字元數上限

text: Narrative entries will appear after the next dreaming cycle.
translated: 下一個夢境週期結束後，就會出現敘事記錄。

text: The Gateway is running an older OpenClaw version
translated: Gateway 正在執行較舊版本的 OpenClaw

text: Optional role-based filter list used by providers that attach roles to chat context. Use this to route privileged or operational role traffic to specialized agents.
translated: 選用的角色篩選清單，適用於會將角色附加至聊天情境的供應商。使用此設定可將特權或維運角色的流量路由至專門的代理程式。

text: Enables TLS termination at the gateway listener so clients connect over HTTPS/WSS directly. Keep enabled for direct internet exposure or any untrusted network boundary.
translated: 在 Gateway 接聽器上啟用 TLS 終止，讓用戶端直接透過 HTTPS/WSS 連線。直接對網際網路開放或位於任何不受信任的網路邊界時，請保持啟用。

text: Sender allow rules for elevated tools, usually keyed by channel/provider identity formats. Use narrow, explicit identities so elevated commands cannot be triggered by unintended users.
translated: 高權限工具的傳送者允許規則，通常以頻道／供應商的身分識別格式作為索引鍵。請使用範圍明確且受限的身分識別，避免非預期使用者觸發高權限命令。

text: Per-agent model override policy. An explicit allow list replaces the default policy for this agent.
translated: 個別代理程式的模型覆寫政策。明確指定的允許清單會取代此代理程式的預設政策。

text: Save API key for {provider} from Control UI
translated: 從 Control UI 儲存 {provider} 的 API 金鑰
瀏覽已傳送訊息的歷史記錄

text: Delivery channel override for mapping outputs (for example "last", "telegram", "discord", "slack", "signal", "imessage", or "msteams"). Keep channel overrides explicit to avoid accidental cross-channel sends.
translated: 覆寫對應輸出的傳送頻道（例如 "last"、"telegram"、"discord"、"slack"、"signal"、"imessage" 或 "msteams"）。請明確指定頻道覆寫值，以免意外跨頻道傳送。

text: Public callback URL Gmail or intermediaries invoke to deliver notifications into this hook pipeline. Keep this URL protected with token validation and restricted network exposure.
translated: Gmail 或中介服務呼叫的公開回呼 URL，用於將通知傳遞至此掛鉤流程。請使用權杖驗證並限制網路存取範圍，以保護此 URL。

text: Use Readability to extract main content from HTML (fallbacks to basic HTML cleanup).
translated: 使用 Readability 從 HTML 擷取主要內容（失敗時改用基本 HTML 清理）。

text: This connection does not have operator.pairing access, so DM requests cannot be reviewed.
translated: 此連線沒有 operator.pairing 存取權限，因此無法審核私訊請求。

text: The administrator access request was rejected.
translated: 管理員存取權限申請已遭拒絕。

text: Text-to-speech policy for reading agent replies aloud on supported voice or audio surfaces. Keep disabled unless voice playback is part of your operator/user workflow.
translated: 文字轉語音原則，用於在支援的語音或音訊介面上朗讀代理回覆。除非語音播放是操作人員或使用者工作流程的一部分，否則請保持停用。

text: Voice Wake is unavailable on this device.
translated: 此裝置無法使用語音喚醒。
最後觀察到的更新紀錄
模型供應商請求 TLS CA

text: Use the system GitHub identity for new runs?
translated: 新執行作業要使用系統的 GitHub 身分嗎？

text: Normalized exec policy selector. Use "auto" for classifier-reviewed approval misses, "ask" for human-reviewed misses, "allowlist" for deterministic safe commands only, or "full" for trusted local operation.
translated: 標準化的執行原則選擇器。使用 "auto" 可將未符合核准條件的命令交由分類器審查，使用 "ask" 則交由人工審查，使用 "allowlist" 僅允許可確定安全的命令，或使用 "full" 進行受信任的本機操作。

text: This file changed in the agent workspace after this draft was started. Reload to take the workspace version, or Overwrite to replace it with this draft.
translated: 開始編輯此草稿後，代理工作區中的此檔案已變更。請重新載入以採用工作區版本，或選擇覆寫以用此草稿取代。
工作階段磁碟高水位目標

text: For trusted local operator access, use the shared Gateway token or password.
translated: 若要以受信任的本機操作員身分存取，請使用共用的 Gateway 權杖或密碼。
驗證 & 使用所選模型

text: Draw on the page, then send the markup to your chat.
translated: 在頁面上繪製，然後將標註傳送至聊天。

text: {host} rejected the supplied Gateway secret. Check that it belongs to this Gateway and try again.
translated: {host} 拒絕了所提供的 Gateway 密鑰。請確認密鑰屬於此 Gateway，然後再試一次。
音訊理解位元組數上限

text: Retrying may duplicate a result after an ambiguous acknowledgement.
translated: 在收到不明確的確認回覆後重試, 可能會重複傳送結果。
您在此 Gateway 上的個人檔案。

text: Enables forwarding of plugin approval requests to configured delivery destinations (default: false). Independent of approvals.exec.enabled.
translated: 啟用將外掛程式核准請求轉送至已設定的傳送目的地（預設值：false）。此設定獨立於 approvals.exec.enabled。

text: Have voice conversations through this device.
translated: 透過此裝置進行語音對話。
重新整理工作階段工作區
瀏覽器設定檔無頭模式
瀏覽器允許 RFC 2544 基準測試範圍
已移除 {removed} 筆重複的夢境記錄。

text: Configured internal hook entry records used to register concrete runtime handlers and metadata. Keep entries explicit and versioned so production behavior is auditable.
translated: 已設定的內部掛鉤項目記錄，用於註冊具體的執行階段處理常式與中繼資料。請明確定義項目並進行版本控管，以便稽核正式環境中的行為。

text: Exactly one memory plugin owns the memory slot. Selecting an engine enables it and disables the others.
translated: 記憶插槽僅由一個記憶外掛使用。 選取引擎會啟用該引擎並停用其他引擎。
